title: Plugin Persistence Strategy
description: Thin file storing only records; manifests always re-read from disk.
body: Which plugins this person has installed, across launches. A record names where a package came from and nothing about what is in it — no surface list, no version, no name. All of that is read back out of the checkout's own `kaava-tool.toml` at load, so a plugin that gains a surface between launches gains it here too, and a record can never disagree with the code it points at.
